results.name: Interview Invitation - Standard
results.body_html_template:
Hi {{candidate_name}},

{{employer_company_name}} has invited you to complete an AI-powered interview for the {{job_role}} role.

The interview is conducted through the LetsHyre desktop application. To get started:

  1. Create your account and complete your candidate profile.
  2. Download and install the LetsHyre desktop application.
  3. Log in and take the AI interview.

Important: When starting your interview, if your selected role matches the role mentioned in the email, continue with the interview. If it is different, choose the custom role option and enter the role mentioned in the email.

Get Started

If the button above does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
{{invite_link}}

Need help downloading and installing the LetsHyre desktop application?

View Setup Guide

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{employer_company_name}}
